label: No holding station in a current above U_crit or the aerobic drag bound
statement_en: Under the swim-limit hypothesis (sustained swimming at most U_crit; drag power rho C_d A U^3 / 2 paid aerobically), no design holds station in a current faster than U_crit, or in one whose drag power exceeds its aerobic ceiling eta E Q Ca.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

scope.basis: critical swimming speed protocol for fishes (Plaut 2001); scup red-muscle top speed (Rome 1992)
assumed: P2b (drag power <= aerobic ceiling): sustained swimming is aerobic only below about 0.8 Ucrit; the final Ucrit increments include anaerobic (white-muscle) power (Plaut and Gordon 1994: no lactate rise up to about 13 BL/s; physics/FICK-CEILING-CHECK.md section 4)
P2b: the aerobic ceiling must be instantiated with a taxon-appropriate MO2max or cardiac output (see fick-principle 1.1.0)
scope.note: P2b compares flat-plate drag power with the Fick aerobic ceiling. Above about 0.8 Ucrit a fish may legitimately add anaerobic power, so a P2b violation there is weaker evidence; and a ceiling built from another taxon’s cardiac output (the snapper value of 58.48 ml/min/kg) is not an upper bound for small cyprinids (Palstra 2010 zebrafish MO2max is 2.8x it).

sources: Plaut I 2001, Critical swimming speed: its ecological relevance. (PMID 11733165, doi:10.1016/s1095-6433(01)00462-7); lean/perturb-sources.json#plaut2001

lean.source:
/-- **No design holds station in a current faster than `U_crit`.** -/
theorem no_station_above_ucrit (L : SwimLimits) {Uswim Ucur P η E Q Ca Cv : ℝ} (hcur : 0 ≤ Ucur)
    (hhold : 0 ≤ Uswim - Ucur) (hU : Uswim ≤ L.uCrit) (hdrag : dragPower L.rho L.Cd L.area Uswim ≤ P)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv) (hsus : P ≤ aerobicPower η E Q Ca Cv)
    (hfast : L.uCrit < Ucur) : False := by
  have := (station_requires L hcur hhold hU hdrag hη hE hQ hCv hsus).1
  linarith

named_hypotheses.source:
/-- Water density, drag coefficient, reference area and the critical (sustained) swimming speed. -/
structure SwimLimits where
  rho : ℝ
  Cd : ℝ
  area : ℝ
  uCrit : ℝ
  rho_pos : 0 < rho
  Cd_pos : 0 < Cd
  area_pos : 0 < area
  uCrit_pos : 0 < uCrit

/-- **No design holds station in a current whose drag power exceeds its aerobic ceiling `eta E Q Ca`.** -/
theorem no_station_above_drag_bound (L : SwimLimits) {Uswim Ucur P η E Q Ca Cv : ℝ} (hcur : 0 ≤ Ucur)
    (hhold : 0 ≤ Uswim - Ucur) (hU : Uswim ≤ L.uCrit) (hdrag : dragPower L.rho L.Cd L.area Uswim ≤ P)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hCv : 0 ≤ Cv) (hsus : P ≤ aerobicPower η E Q Ca Cv)
    (hbig : η * E * Q * Ca < dragPower L.rho L.Cd L.area Ucur) : False := by
  have := (station_requires L hcur hhold hU hdrag hη hE hQ hCv hsus).2
  linarith
